extra.text: Chronic LBP must have lasted 12 weeks or longer.
The low back pain must be nonspecific, with no identifiable systemic cause.
The low back pain must not be associated with surgery.
The low back pain must not be associated with pregnancy.
Up to 12 visits in 90 days are covered initially.
An additional 8 sessions are covered only for patients demonstrating improvement.
No more than 20 acupuncture treatments may be administered annually.
Treatment must be discontinued if the patient is not improving or is regressing.
Physicians furnishing acupuncture must do so in accordance with applicable state requirements.
PAs, NPs/CNSs, and auxiliary personnel must have a masters or doctoral level degree in acupuncture or Oriental Medicine from an ACAOM-accredited school.
PAs, NPs/CNSs, and auxiliary personnel must have a current, full, active, and unrestricted license to practice acupuncture.
Auxiliary personnel furnishing acupuncture must be under the appropriate level of supervision required by regulations.
Acupuncture (including dry needling) is non-covered for any condition other than cLBP.
